newsitem.title: USA: May December same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: May December same store sales up.

text.p: May Department Stores Co said Thursday that its same-store sales for the five-week period ended January 4 rose 2.7 percent.
Total sales for that period increased 8.8 percent to $2.31 billion from $2.12 billion a year ago.
Year-to-date same store sales rose 4.2 percent, while total sales for that period gained 11 percent to $11.07 billion from $9.97 billion.

Adjusting for a calendar shift from the 53-week year in 1995 and its impact on December 1996 results, May said same store sales rose 12.2 percent for December. Total sales on an adjusted basis rose 18.8 percent in December to $2.31 billion from $1.94 billion.

Sales have been restated to exclude stores that were closed and not replaced. Year-to-date revenues, including sales of non-replaced closed stores and finance charge revenue, were $11.39 billion in 1996 and $10.3 billion in 1995.
Year-to-date, May has opened a total of 28 new department stores, including 13 acquired locations. This completed May's planned store openings for fiscal 1996.
May operates 365 department stores in 30 states and the District of Columbia.
